description: Search speech activities in parliamentary term 9 or 10, default 10, or retrieve one with mode get and speech_id. Text and title search return activity metadata, not transcripts. Follow document_ids with euparl_search_documents mode get and any returned parent_document_ids to source files. Use euparl_list_reference topic activity_types for activity_type codes. Get rejects search filters and nondefault paging. Search exposes at most 10000 results; continue with page.next_offset when present, otherwise narrow text, title, person_id, activity_type or sitting dates.

activity_type.description: Search-only code from euparl_list_reference topic activity_types; case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

mode.description: Default search discovers speech activities; get requires speech_id and rejects search filters.

person_id.description: Search-only numeric MEP identifier, person/ prefix or exact public person URI.

sitting_date.description: Search-only sitting date YYYY-MM-DD; start date when a range end is supplied.

sitting_date_end.description: Search-only inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD; requires sitting_date and cannot precede it.

speech_id.description: Get-only canonical activity ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or exact public URI.

term.description: Search-only parliamentary term 9 or 10; omitted search defaults to 10. Omit in get mode.

text.description: Search-only keywords in the selected language; matching does not guarantee transcript output.

title.description: Search-only published activity title keywords in the selected language.

name: euparl_search_speeches

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: An activity code, identifier, language or date range is unsupported, or offset plus effective limit exceeds the 10000-result search window. `invalid_mode_fields`: Get lacks speech_id, supplies search filters or nondefault paging; search supplies speech_id. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Get-only publication result; false for missing or empty detail.

items.description: Whole speech activity records on the search page; absent in get mode.
Speech activity metadata and source-document references, without extracted spoken text.

activity_type.description: Published speech activity-type code or URI.

document_ids.description: Published recording documents; use euparl_search_documents mode get, then follow parent_document_ids if needed.

participants.description: All published speech participations, preserving order.

person_ids.description: Published person participants for this participation.

items.description: Canonical person identifier accepted by euparl_get_mep.

speech_id.description: Canonical activity identifier accepted by this tool in get mode.

title.description: Published activity label and its actual selected language; not a transcript.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Search continuation metadata; absent in get mode.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

speech.description: Published activity detail when get succeeds.

activity_type.description: Published speech activity-type code or URI.

document_ids.description: Published recording documents; use euparl_search_documents mode get, then follow parent_document_ids if needed.

title.description: Published activity label and its actual selected language; not a transcript.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.
